title: CordProtocolsView
description: Response of GET /ui/crew/{astronaut_id}/views/cord-protocols: the two independent cord-resistance sessions (back straight, maximum flexion), each with its personal Earth reference, its latest in-flight follow-up, whether one is due and an optional calculated length estimate. A measurement counts only if its session completed and the feature has quality at or above the configured minimum score. The estimate is calculated from the cord measurements under explicit assumptions: it is not a measured length, is not clinically validated and never feeds the triage (level, recommendations, escalation).

cadence_days.description: Days between in-flight measurements of each posture. Configurable; the default is an example, not a clinical cadence (pending Aguado).

measurement.title: CordMeasurement
measurement.description: Latest valid cord resistance of one posture in one gravity setting.

earth_measurement.title: CordEarthMeasurement
earth_measurement.description: A measurement taken pre-flight on Earth.

follow_up_measurement.title: CordFollowUpMeasurement
follow_up_measurement.description: A measurement taken in a gravity setting other than Earth's.

estimate.title: CordLengthEstimate
estimate.description: Calculated, never measured: the length of the span between the back contacts estimated from the follow-up and Earth reference resistances with the bench model. The flags state it explicitly so a UI cannot present it as a measurement.

assumptions.description: ASSUMPTION_UNIFORM_RESISTANCE: resistance per unit length is uniform along the cord. ASSUMPTION_NEGLIGIBLE_CONTACT_RESISTANCE: contact resistance is negligible. ASSUMPTION_UNIFORM_DEFORMATION: the cord deforms uniformly and its contacts stay fixed to the material.

due_reason.description: CORD_NO_EARTH_REFERENCE: pre-flight and no valid Earth reference yet. CORD_NO_FOLLOW_UP: in flight and no valid follow-up yet. CORD_FOLLOW_UP_OVERDUE: the last valid follow-up is cadence_days old or older. CORD_UP_TO_DATE: nothing is due (reference taken pre-flight, follow-up recent, or the mission is not in the phase that asks for one).

estimate_unavailable.description: Why there is no estimate; null when there is one. ESTIMATE_NO_EARTH_REFERENCE and ESTIMATE_NO_FOLLOW_UP: a measurement is missing. ESTIMATE_REFERENCE_LENGTH_UNKNOWN: the distance between the contacts in this posture is not measured (only the straight back has it; pending Aguado). ESTIMATE_OUT_OF_MODEL_RANGE: a resistance is outside the bench model. ESTIMATE_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: the engine did not answer.
